purpose: Add a deterministic Navigation Continuity Watchdog so recoverable navigation/tool/derived-state errors are diagnosed, metabolized and resumed without resetting the active mission or adding workers.
allowed: development-branch watchdog code/tests/evidence within current unconsumed Step-002 packet
bounded deterministic retries with explicit max attempts and idempotency/dedupe
rebuild derived progress/status/cache metadata from authoritative durable state
quarantine or classify reproducible transient logs/cache/debug/temp metadata
route to the next already-authorized A/B/C role or HUMAN_GATE
retain compact root-cause lesson and recovery outcome
required_invariants: owner input or recoverable tool failure never resets mission_id/status/step/current_role/pending packet/hash/lease
packet/hash/authorization/lease/role contradictions fail closed and are never synthesized away
retry cannot loop forever and duplicate retry cannot duplicate execution
recovery returns to the same mission and legal next role/packet
no slot4/new formal worker/new mission is created for recovery
runtime metabolism stores only compact lesson/outcome; raw logs/scratch remain transient or quarantined
human_gate: recovery cannot prove authoritative next state
